synopsis: STAR WARS: THE COMPLETE SAGA is the ultimate guide to all six films. Readers can relive each film step by step in one amazing book. From Qui-Gon's discovery of Anakin on Tatooine to Anakin's fall to the dark side and Luke's battle to save his father - THE COMLETE SAGA is a must-have for all STAR WARS fans.
title: Star Wars: The Complete Saga
